text:
Mira (new-hire): hey team — setting up integration tests locally + in CI. Which API key should I use so tests never hit prod? also worried about quota/429s when CI runs parallel jobs.

sam-devex: use a sandbox key for both local dev and CI. create a service sandbox key for your team (so you can rotate/revoke without touching personal keys). don’t check it into the repo — use CI secret / local env.

Mira (new-hire): quick Q — do you recommend one shared sandbox key for the whole team CI, or one per pipeline worker? which avoids throttles best?

ops-jen: we usually give the CI a single sandbox service key and spread traffic across workers with client-side rate-limiting. if you spawn N parallel jobs, each should do backoff on 429. watch the headers we return: `X-RateLimit-Remaining` + `X-RateLimit-Reset` and check `Retry-After` when present. exponential backoff + jitter works well.

Mira (new-hire): can you paste a tiny example for env + curl so I can wire up CI secrets?

sam-devex: sure — put the key into CI secret (e.g., `REDWOOD_SANDBOX_KEY`), locally `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...`. simple curl example:

```
export REDWOOD_API_KEY="sk-sandbox-<redacted>"
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-small","input":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood-inference.dev/v1/generate
```

sam-devex: for CI we prefer non-streaming requests (simpler failure modes). record canned responses for unit tests and spike integration tests against sandbox.

Mira (new-hire): streaming caused flakes locally. should I disable streaming in CI completely?

ops-jen: yes for CI, toggle `stream=false`. if you need to test streaming behaviour, run a single dedicated e2e job hitting sandbox with rate-limits scaled down. alternately, mock the stream and assert framing.

security-ron: reminders from sec: never log full keys, rotate service sandbox keys monthly (or when someone leaves), store secrets in our Vault/CI secrets manager. if you suspect a leak, revoke the key immediately from Console and ping sec@redwood.

ci-bot: NOTE: current org sandbox quota for `eng-platform` is 200 rps and 10k tokens/min. open a ticket in #help if you need a quota bump — include expected concurrency and request pattern.

devex-bot: Pro tip: for flaky network tests, run a local redwood-dev-proxy that returns stable fixtures + simulates slow streams. Checkout `devex/tools/redwood-dev-proxy` in the monorepo.

Mira (new-hire): awesome, thanks all — i'll set up a service sandbox key, wire to CI secrets, disable streaming for parallel jobs, and open a help ticket if we need more quota. tagging @sam-devex to help with the service key creation. :thumbsup:
